propositions: Write-op parameter surfaces (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across lib, CLI, and MCP adapters with no mechanical enforcement, allowing silent parameter drift to go undetected.

A conformance oracle suite mechanically asserts behavioral write-op parity by executing a single shared contract table against all three adapters, catching accept/reject divergences and missing parameter exposure without LLM or change-detector.

MCP adapter currently does not expose reason, caused_by, and force parameters on transition and claim operations, recorded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago ticket until those gaps close.

Runtime conditional rules (close_class required, reason required for bug-close) are asserted behaviorally through contract rows that reject identically across all three adapters, enforcing semantic constraints beyond shape.

The oracle reuses and extends the existing three-adapter harness (Adapter protocol, Outcome, LibraryAdapter/CliAdapter/McpAdapter) rather than creating parallel drivers, threading write-op inputs through a unified interface.
